explanation: Stars such as Lata Mangeshkar and her younger sister Asha Bhosle recorded thousands of film songs, mimed on screen by generations of actors.

claims.text: In Indian cinema, singers whose recordings actors lip-sync on screen are called playback singers.
Session singers, backing singers and dubbing artists are not the term for these film singers.
Asha Bhosle is Lata Mangeshkar's younger sister.
Lata Mangeshkar and Asha Bhosle each recorded thousands of film songs.
